last_resurrection.title: Port conflict with multiple "host:<port range>:port" services
last_resurrection.one_line_why: Docker Desktop 4.0 introduced deterministic port allocation engine that now supports automatic conflict resolution.
last_resurrection.one_line_summary: Docker Compose should automatically resolve overlapping host port ranges to prevent container startup failures.
